text:
Maya K: Quick design review for the model browser — dropping the Figma here: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ. Main things I want eyes on: filter persistence when switching views, compare table density (rows feel cramped), performance badges (label + contrast), and how version pinning behaves across comparisons.

Ben L: Saw the mock. Two quick ideas — 1) collapse advanced filters under a single "More" chip so the main rail stays lightweight, show a small count badge when collapsed; 2) pinning should be explicit per-user and we should show a small toast explaining "Pinned: this comparison will keep this version locked" :info:

Alex R: Implementation notes — compare table uses virtualization which is why collapsing rows makes focus jump. We can avoid reflow by keeping a stable element height and toggling visibility. Small CSS hint:
```
.compare-row { min-height: 56px; }
.compare-row.hidden { visibility: hidden; height: 0; }
```
Also keyboard nav breaks when we re-render; using `aria-activedescendant` on the listbox helps preserve focus.

Olivia S: From research sessions users assume "performance" badge = quality of answer. We should clarify. Suggest renaming to "Throughput" or "Latency" depending on metric and add a tooltip like: "p50 85ms · p90 210ms · est $0.05 / 1k tokens". Also accessibility: current purple badge fails contrast on smaller sizes — need a darker token.

Ben L: Microcopy suggestion: instead of "Pin version" use "Lock version for this comparison" — more explicit. Also add a small confirmation on pin (inline toast + undo) because people have accidentally pinned in the past.

Alex R: For filter stickiness, easiest robust approach is to encode filters in the URL query + localStorage fallback. That gives shareable links and preserves when they navigate away: `?filters=model:zoo,quant=4bit&sort=latency`.

Maya K: Nice. Can we make the compare header sticky but compress it on scroll (so we keep model badges visible but shrink controls)? Also we should gate the new compact compare behind a feature flag for canary rollout: `catalog_compact_compare_v2`.

ui-bot: Feature flag `catalog_compact_compare_v2` created in staging. Use `/ff catalog_compact_compare_v2 on` to toggle for test orgs.

Olivia S: One more a11y nit — voiceover reads badge as just a number because our `aria-label` is the count. Make `aria-label` descriptive, e.g. `aria-label="Throughput, p90 210ms"` so it reads properly.

Alex R: I'll do the CSS and aria PRs. Plan: PR today for contrast & aria labels, then another PR for keyboard fixes. Will add the URL filters helper util.

Maya K: Thanks everyone. Sync tomorrow 10am (design + eng) to finalize microcopy and rollout plan. I'll add agenda and link to the branch. :calendar:
